status_note: KUNABUGS-COPYTRIM-REMAT-0001 verification fixture: Merge::allocateCopyTrim does NOT re-materialize an explicit COPY for dynamic-hash temps at firstuse in the locked oracle — merge.cc has zero DynamicHash references, the dynamic-mapping chain never allocates ops, and a folded COPY breaks the use-anchored hash so the entry silently detaches on BOTH runtimes (fold_relocate_fn is byte-identical). The five MISMATCH residuals are adjacent real gaps found by the same fixture (Rugra unique-hash anchor divergence, setSymbolProperties return surfacing, late implied-CAST retarget omission, and the two inert dynamic-mapping Action stubs), all outside merge.rs.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: attemptDynamicMapping/attemptDynamicMappingLate take SymbolEntry* + DynamicHash& by reference and mutate the located Varnode through vn->setSymbolProperties/vn->setSymbolEntry; the Action perform(Funcdata&) walks the ScopeLocal dynamic list by iterator (entry addresses taken with ++iter before the call). The Rust twin passes (first_use_addr, hash, size, equate, union_facet, name) by value and mutates via MAPPED flag + symbol_table insert; the action-level twin calls the registered stubs.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: gatherFirstLevelVars iterates fd->beginOp(addr)..endOp(addr) matching transtable[opcode]==opcVal with slot<0 taking op output (isnotattached follows loneDescend through skipped ops) and 0<=slot<numInput taking the input (isnotattached follows getDef through skipped ops); attemptDynamicMapping/Late run per dynamic entry in list order; the fixture censuses ops via beginOpAlive..endOpAlive sorted by (name,address) or opcode-only where addresses are not fixture-controlled (merge trims take the incoming block stop).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Action::count increments only when attemptDynamicMapping/Late returns true (merge.cc has no counter here; coreaction.cc:4862/4879); attemptDynamicMapping's boolean return is Varnode::setSymbolProperties' return value, which can be false even when the mapped flag was set — the C4 case shows count=0 while mapped=1. The Rust stubs have no counting state and report 0.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: DynamicHash::pieceTogetherHash folds edges in ToOpEdge::operator< order (SeqNum address, then order, then slot) and anchors at the FIRST edge whose slot varnode is the root (else op_edge[0] with the not-attached bit); the hash carries [attached:1][method:4][translated-opcode:7][slot:5][reg:32] plus collision total/position bits; CAST and COPY-adjacent skip walks differ between the runtimes (DYNHASH-UNIQUE-ANCHOR-0001). The op censuses sort by (opcode-name, address) / opcode-name for byte-stable projections.

oracle.instrumentation_policy: No oracle source changes: the fixture only calls public APIs (Funcdata::attemptDynamicMapping/Late, Scope::addDynamicSymbol, DynamicHash::uniqueHash/calcHash, Merge::mergeAddrTied/mergeMarker, Action::perform, Action::count read through the varmap_dynamicsym-style private/protected access shim that never edits production behavior).

analysis_options.entry: Direct construction per case: hand-built SSA bodies on fresh fd.clear() state (BfdArchitecture+real GetStr Funcdata on the Ghidra side; bare Funcdata+ScopeLocal with the production gcc localrange window on the Rust side). Dynamic entries minted through the production uniqueHash/calcHash + addDynamicSymbol path with the runtime-computed (hash, firstUseAddress) pair. Merges driven through Merge::mergeAddrTied + Merge::mergeMarker (LowlevelError caught to inspect the trims, mirroring merge_trim_lane). Function-level cases call Funcdata::attemptDynamicMapping/attemptDynamicMappingLate directly; action-level cases call ActionDynamicMapping/ActionDynamicSymbols perform.
analysis_options.funcproto_state: none (no prototype locking; register temporaries chosen outside the cspec [8,39) param range and outside the stack window so no static symbol interferes)

rugra_source.archive_policy: Snapshot Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock + src/** + crates/** from the pinned base commit; the fixtures and this metadata are overlaid from the working tree.

fold_relocate_fn.covers: Use-anchored dynamic entry (calcHash(op3,0,0)) + RulePropagateCopy fold: relocation fails bilaterally (recomputed position hash of the folded-through varnode never equals the minted hash), nothing mapped, ZERO ops created, dynamic entry survives untouched. CASTFUSE-A candidate ③ literal falsification: the oracle has no COPY re-materialization for dynamic-hash temps.

refind_attach_fn.covers: Def-anchored uniqueHash re-find: attach (mapped=1), already-labelled guard on the second call, and zero new ops all MATCH; the boolean return diverges (oracle surfaces Varnode::setSymbolProperties' false; Rugra returns true unconditionally) and the minted hash value itself diverges (same anchor address, different H).

late_cast_retarget.covers: attemptDynamicMappingLate on an implied CAST-adjacent temp: oracle anchors tmp NOT-ATTACHED at the reading op (CAST is a skipped hash op) and attaches the explicit c0 across the CAST; Rugra anchors at c0's defining COPY output and attaches the implied tmp itself. Mint hash+address and both after-census rows diverge.

trim_dynamic_high.covers: CMOV diamond (phi(X,fX)) with a dynamic entry on X: mergeAddrTied+mergeMarker trims MATCH exactly (lane rewires copy@b1(X)/copy@b2(fX), 4-COPY census, dynamic entry count untouched by merge, no dynamic-driven op anywhere) — merge-side candidate ③ falsification; only the minted hash value line diverges.

action_walk_level.covers: ActionDynamicMapping::perform on the resolvable shape: the oracle walks beginDynamic()/endDynamic() and attaches from the action level (mapped=1; count stays 0 only because attemptDynamicMapping returns setSymbolProperties' false); Rugra's registered stub is inert (mapped stays 0).

action_late_walk.covers: ActionDynamicSymbols::perform on the clean C1b shape (the production state — a thrown mergeMarker aborts the decompile so the late action never sees the trims): oracle count=1/status=1 with the late attach (mapped=1); Rugra's registered stub is inert (count=0/status=0, mapped=0).

residual_union.detail: DynamicHash::unique_hash_vn produces a different H than oracle DynamicHash::uniqueHash on the same IR for every vn-rooted mint in this fixture (same anchor address for the non-CAST shapes, different 17-bit header and/or reg CRC; for the CAST-adjacent tmp even the anchor differs: oracle not-attached at the reading op 0x2020, Rugra attached at c0's defining COPY output 0x2000). calc_hash_op(op, slot, 0) is byte-exact (fold_relocate_fn mint H identical), so the divergence is inside the calcHash(Varnode*, method) walk / champion loop (skip-op traversal and/or attached-edge pick), not in the bit packing or CRC. Self-consistent (Rugra locates its own hash in its own IR), but cross-run identity with the oracle is broken — affects buildDynamicSymbol minting quality and hash-stability across passes.

Funcdata::attemptDynamicMapping returns true whenever size matches (funcdata.rs:12901-12908); Ghidra returns Varnode::setSymbolProperties(entry)'s boolean, which is false in the C1b shape even though the mapped flag was set — the false return also keeps ActionDynamicMapping's count at 0 while the attach happened (visible in action_walk_level).
residual_union.evidence: call|case=refind_attach_fn|fn=attemptDynamicMapping|res oracle=0 rugra=1; act count oracle=0 with mapped=1

residual_union.detail: attempt_dynamic_mapping_late omits funcdata_varnode.cc:1373-1386 (documented RUGRA-GAP at funcdata.rs:12971): when the hash-located varnode is implied and CAST-adjacent with an explicit other side, the oracle attaches the symbol to that explicit varnode; Rugra attaches the implied varnode. Output-visible whenever a dynamic symbol lands on an implied cast temp — the named variable the oracle keeps explicit is exactly the over-inlining shape of CASTFUSE-A.
